summary_1line: Explains sacred AUM and Siva Linga, then recounts devotional legends including Nandikesvara, Kannappa’s extreme devotion, and Nandanar’s early life.

image_candidates.scene_text: The hunter Tinnadu plucks out his own eye and presses it onto the bleeding eye of the Siva idol in desperate devotion.
A spider, a cobra with a jeweled hood, and an elephant each worship the same Siva Linga in their own ways in the forest shrine of Kalahasti.
The grieving cow and calf leap together into the Reva river near Nandikesvara as Karma Siddha watches in shock from the riverbank.
